text:
If I could rate this experience any less I would.  Step into Rex Auto Service being forewarned! Prepare for the worst. The most unprofessional shop I have ever encountered in my 50 years! Simply walk in and look at the disorganization and sad conditions of the place. I truly feel sorry for the sole overworked mechanic that works there (look at the low lighting conditions).
I dropped off my car early hoping to hear a diagnosis by end of day; heard nothing. Phone calls go unanswered. I visit the shop on day 2 and hear what they are planning to do. Unable to contact them once again, I visited the shop again on day 4 and was told that they need more time after changing 2 spark plugs and 2 coils (a one hour job). Day 7! Phone calls were useless. I visited Rex Auto Repair once again only to be told the EXACT same thing I was told 3 days prior. Evidently no work was done on it for the past 3 days with no reason and no apologies other than “we’ve been busy”. I decided to just give up on Rex Auto and would suggest anyone reading this would do themselves a favor by doing the same. There is no way they can stay in business like this for much longer. Good luck!!

They used to be good until change of management.

I brought in an '07 Murano because loss of power.m and knocking noise on acceleration. They said there was no knocking noise and it needed new valve cover gasket. I approved the work but when I asked to see the old gasket I was shown one that was in fairly good condition, not bittle or cracked, but cut completely in half. As I left and drove the knocking noise was still there and the car died a few months later due to the cats being clogged (loss of acceleration). They misdiagnosed it or most likely didn't even do an actual diagnosis and did work that it didn't need then overcharged me for it! Beware.

I appreciate the service I got at Rex auto repair. My car had problem with the engine ignition. I gave Rex auto a call and told Jacky my car problem. I brought the car in the same day and Jacky looked through the car, explained what he …

Truly recommend it. My car is fixed very quickly with a reasonable price. The cost for oil change is the best compared to all of the auto services in SF bay area. My "check engine light on" problem is solved cleverly without changing the part. Honest and economical.

Had a flat tire. I called and was told to come by whenever is was convenient. Took all of 30 minutes and $30 to remove the screw in the tire and patch it up. New to the area but with service like that, they now have a new customer for my car service needs.
No Saturday hours, and they are open until 6pm, not 7, but they did an excellent job on my cars oil change.

Took in my car for a check engine light issue. Over the phone they quoted me a hundred dollars to fix the knock sensor which is what they think was causing it but they weren’t sure. I responded with “Wow only a hundred? Ok perfect let’s try …

My work van got a large screw in a tire. Went to several gas stations and repair services with no able or willing to fix on a Friday late afternoon. It's a heavy van and most tow services will not tow it, so I was  concerned.  Luckily I Google and found Rex service . 5 minutes a day $30 later I was on my way..thanks guys!
Very friendly and nice service. I had a nail in my tire, showed up without an appointment and they patched it in less than 15 minutes. Great price too!

While my experience at the shop was great I am not happy that the tire I paid to be repaired was not even fixed. I didn’t realize it until the tire went flat again a few days later and I noticed the mail was still in the tire and no …

I went in with possible tire replacement. They were able to patch up my tire and serviced me within 10 minutes. They were super informative for all my questions (most mechanic shops belittle you or try to overcharge) and were so affordable. Def coming here if I have more auto needs!!!

I took my Hyundai Elantra in and asked them for guidance on a whirring sound and some technical issues. they saw that I needed a drive belt change and an AC belt change. This entailed opening up the engine quite a bit, but they did it all within a day and for $260 - a great rate. Car runs beautifully now!

I had a knock/ticking starting to get louder on my Dodge and didn't want to pay the 190 at Dodge to have it "diagnosed" . I knew I needed an oil change anyway. Called Rex and asked how much for oil change, He quoted a low price, and said he …

My car wasn’t moving and they were so kind to let me tow my car to their shop for an inspection on a very last minute notice. Even though it ended up being an electrical issue and they couldn’t fix it they didn’t charge me for the inspection. Such a kind and honest business! I would bring my car here again 😍 …

Finding a mechanic that won’t overcharge you  is like gold in the the city. I live around the corner, so I’ve gone there several times over the years for mostly minor, but some major things. Anytime Rex identifies something simple that I …
Stopped by without an appointment for a tire repair or replacement. Was back out with a patched tire in less than 30 mins. Super nice staff, quick service, and great price!
Helped me fix a flat tire same day. So appreciative. Fair rates and kind, professional, quality service!
Great service. Great work. If you want a good honest reliable mechanic, this is your place. They are the best I've found in the city

Rex is one cool dude . he is Straight foward. His shop isbt the biggest . I suggest calling ahead of time to maks sure hes not busy . Rex knows his cars well. I recommend him in the sunset district in sam Francisco other than him close by is downtown or daily city or comma and south

Had brakes and tires for our 350z... fairly priced good work... what really got my loyalty is when I had mentioned that we had a metal on metal sound from our front end that the dealership said it's just the way the car sounds... well Jacky found out it was just a loose bolt...he tightened it and our car sounds like a new car!!!
Great neighborhood auto service. Honest service with reasonable prices. They don't recommend or perform service you don't need. I've been going there for years.

Quick service with great customer service attitude. Helped me figure out the problem very quick with the fair charge on service and the replacement. The only problem is that this place could be cramped during rush hour.

Came by asking for a checkup, got me in within 15 minutes. The mechanic gave me a full rundown of under the hood and gave me an incredible price to fix a big problem. Going in next week to get it done
Best auto shop in San Francisco the most honest people and fair prices! Sally the front desk lady is so great and informative

I asked for a full diagnostics test and he didn't they did not perform nothing they told me they opened up my differential and found metal shavings in my gears eating up and I still have the factory seal on my differential he did not open …
Great job, great prices, really friendly and quick. Got me in on short notice and got my car working again!
No nonsense shop, been going here since i moved to the neighborhood. They get the job done without costing you an arm and a leg, runs a a tight shop. Hard to find shops like this anywhere
Fast, communicative, and super helpful!
Came in for tire replacement.  Very nice, fast and accommodating, reasonable prices
The owner/worker is honest and will tell you if the car really needs servicing. They won't upsell you.
came to this place for years. my go to mechanics. skilled staff and cheap price. never disappointed.
Definitely a good shop. They are knowledgeable and able to figure out what the problem might with the car.
Always been super helpful, and honest. They will never prescribe extra services to make a quick buck.
friendly, quick, did a great job on brake pad replacement
These guys are honest and fair. Helped me out with some codes even though they couldn't perform service. Thanks guys!
Great! Auto Repair Services. Keeps my car driving well.
Kind, honest, fast and loyal. Won’t go anywhere else in the city. Thank you, Rex!
It is easy to book, the technicians are excellent, and they are affordable.
Super fast. Honest pricing. Totally recommended!
Nice and quick service with helpful staff. Would recommend.
